get_hf: compute a Hartree-Fock solution for a molecule using PySCF with a specified basis set and spin configuration
eval_orbitals: evaluate SCF molecular orbitals at given electron positions for alpha and beta spin channels
make_pretrain_step: create a callable that performs one optimization step to match neural network orbitals to Hartree-Fock orbitals
pretrain_hartree_fock: run Hartree-Fock pretraining iterations to initialize FermiNet orbitals to closely match SCF solutions
review_pretrain_module: review the pretrain module functions for Hartree-Fock pretraining and orbital evaluation utilities
